new.title: Minimum numbers of raw sites and read wires for uniformly distributed binary reports
new.statement:
let Word := fun k : Nat => Fin k → ZMod 2
let localRule := fun (n : Nat) (D : Fin n → Finset (Fin n)) (T : Fin n → Word n → ZMod 2) =>
  ∀ i x y, (∀ j ∈ D i, x j = y j) → T i x = T i y
let observed := fun (n m : Nat) (Q : Fin n → Word m) (U : Finset (Fin n))
    (T : Fin n → Word n → ZMod 2) (b : Word n) (z : U → ZMod 2) (r : Fin m) =>
  let x := fun i : Fin n => if h : i ∈ U then z ⟨i,h⟩ else b i
  ∑ i, (x i + T i x) * Q i r
let uniform := fun (n m : Nat) (D : Fin n → Finset (Fin n)) (Q : Fin n → Word m)
    (U : Finset (Fin n)) =>
  ∀ T, localRule n D T → ∀ b v,
    2^m * Nat.card {z : U → ZMod 2 // observed n m Q U T b z = v} = 2^U.card
let readers := fun (n : Nat) (D : Fin n → Finset (Fin n)) (j : Fin n) =>
  (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => j ∈ D i)).card
let wires := fun (n : Nat) (D : Fin n → Finset (Fin n)) => ∑ i, (D i).card
∀ m : Nat, 1 ≤ m →
  let N := 2^m - 1
  (∃ (D : Fin N → Finset (Fin N)) (Q : Fin N → Word m),
    (∀ i, i ∉ D i) ∧
    (∀ i, (Finset.univ.filter (fun r => Q i r ≠ 0)).card ≤ 2) ∧
    (∀ j, readers N D j = m-1) ∧ wires N D = N*(m-1) ∧
    (∀ U, uniform N m D Q U ↔ U = Finset.univ)) ∧
  (∀ (n : Nat) (D : Fin n → Finset (Fin n)) (Q : Fin n → Word m) (W : Finset (Fin n)),
    W.card = N → uniform n m D Q Finset.univ →
    (∀ j ∈ W, ¬ uniform n m D Q (Finset.univ.erase j)) →
    N ≤ n ∧ (∀ j ∈ W, m-1 ≤ readers n D j) ∧ N*(m-1) ≤ wires n D)
new.unlocks: This would give the exact number of sensor read wires needed to make all possible nonzero report parities require different raw sites.
new.context: Index sites by nonzero masks. Assign unit columns to singletons and pair columns to the next pair in cyclic order. Give each site a reader basis of its orthogonal hyperplane. Handle m=1,2 directly. Each indispensable site has a private mask. The reader equations and its own odd parity isolate that mask, forcing reader rank m-1. A network with the required uniformity and a designated site with fewer readers would refute the bound. A one-gate-smaller circuit companion cannot exist here because the term counts read wires and gives no circuit or gate budget.

changed.title: Proper graph colorings index the possible parity biases of scheduled cyclic sensor reports
changed.statement:
∀ (n : Nat) (es : List (Fin n × Fin n)) (s d r : Nat),
  0 < s → 4 ≤ r → 2*s ≤ d → d < 3*s →
  let m := 2*n+1
  let lo := fun i : Fin n => (1 : Nat) <<< (2*i.val+1)
  let hi := fun i : Fin n => (1 : Nat) <<< (2*i.val+2)
  let cols : List Nat := [1,1,1] ++
    (List.finRange n).flatMap (fun i => [lo i, hi i, 1]) ++
    es.flatMap (fun e => [lo e.1 ^^^ lo e.2, hi e.1 ^^^ hi e.2, 1])
  let q := cols.length
  let k := q*s
  let l := d+1-s
  let Y := Fin (2^m)
  let C := Fin n → Fin 3
  let proper := fun (c : C) => ∀ e ∈ es, c e.1 ≠ c e.2
  let normal := fun (c : C) => (List.finRange n).foldl
    (fun p i => p ||| (((c i).val+1) <<< (2*i.val+1))) (1 : Nat)
  let par := fun (mask : Nat) (y : Y) => (List.range m).foldl
    (fun b j => xor b (mask.testBit j && y.val.testBit j)) false
  let rot := fun (h w : Nat) =>
    ((w <<< (h % k)) ||| (w >>> (k - h % k))) % 2^k
  let step := fun (w : Nat) =>
    (List.range k).foldl (fun acc i => acc ||| ((xor (w.testBit i)
      (!(w.testBit ((i+1)%k)) && w.testBit ((i+2)%k))).toNat <<< i)) 0
  let state := fun (col : Bool) (w name : Nat) (c : Fin r → Fin (2^k)) =>
    let g := if col then 2 else 1
    (List.finRange r).foldl (fun x j =>
      step (x ^^^ rot g x ^^^ rot (k-g) x) ^^^
        rot (if col then 3*(j.val+1)+1 else 2*j.val) w ^^^ (c j).val)
      (rot (if col then 3 else 1) w ^^^ name)
  let reach := fun col : Bool => if col then 7*r-2 else 5*r-3
  let delay := fun col : Bool => if col then 3*r+1 else 2*r-2
  let sign := fun b : Bool => if b then (-1 : ℤ) else 1
  let bits := fun (a x : Nat) => (List.range a).map (fun i => x.testBit i)
  let sched := fun (c : Fin r → Fin (2^k)) =>
    (List.finRange r).flatMap (fun j => bits k (c j).val)
  let colors := (Finset.univ : Finset C).filter proper
  ∃ D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo D ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (3*k+2*r*k+q+m+(k+1)) D ∧
    D.size ≤ 2^44*(k+r+m+5)^16*(1+colors.card*(2^(l+s)+2^(3*l))) ∧
    ∀ (nr nc : Fin (2^k)) (cr cc : Fin r → Fin (2^k)) (off : Fin k) (bank : Fin q → Bool),
      let p := fun i : Fin q => (off.val+i.val*s)%k
      let sensor := fun (i : Fin q) (w : Nat) =>
        (state (bank i) w (if bank i then nc.val else nr.val)
          (if bank i then cc else cr)).testBit ((p i + delay (bank i))%k)
      let valid := ∀ i, reach (bank i) ≤ d
      let report := fun (w : Nat) => (List.finRange q).foldl
        (fun z i => if sensor i w then z ^^^ cols.get i else z) (0 : Nat)
      let chi := fun (c : C) (w : Nat) => (List.range m).foldl
        (fun b j => xor b ((normal c).testBit j && w.testBit j)) false
      let hits := fun y : Y => Nat.card {w : Fin (2^k) // report w.val = y.val}
      (valid → ∀ y : Y, (2 : ℤ)^m * (hits y : ℤ) = (2 : ℤ)^k +
        ∑ c ∈ colors, sign (par (normal c) y) *
          (∑ w : Fin (2^k), sign (chi c (report w.val)))) ∧
      (valid → colors.card = 0 → ∀ y : Y, hits y = 2^(k-m)) ∧
      ∀ (y : Y) (t : Fin (2^(k+1))),
        D.eval (bits k nr.val ++ bits k nc.val ++ sched cr ++ sched cc ++ bits k off.val ++
          List.ofFn bank ++ bits m y.val ++ bits (k+1) t.val) = decide (valid ∧ t.val ≤ hits y)
